title: The word for brass band and orchestra
summary: De De only knows 'band'; he says in the old days there was no orchestra, brass bands played dance music.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: What about brass bands? What's the word for brass band? You remember?
Bomb. That's all I know. The word band.
I'm going to say bomb. A bong. A band.
What do they say for orchestra?
Probably the same because the brass band played in those times. There was no such thing as orchestra. It was a band. Brass band played dance music right on. You know what I'm done?
